stem: What is the author's primary purpose for writing the article?

options.label: A
options.text: To convince readers that children will learn valuable life lessons only if they are not rewarded simply for participation

options.label: B
options.text: To describe the types of awards that parents and coaches should give to children for their accomplishments

options.label: C
options.text: To explain to readers the benefits of rewarding children for their participation in competitive activities

options.label: D
options.text: To emphasize the unfairness of organizations that provide awards to all children regardless of merit
